The correlation between praf and PIP3 in the data is about -0.01, so the two are essentially uncorrelated. The known signalling network for this data (the Sachs et al. flow cytometry dataset) agrees. In it, praf is regulated by PKA and PKC and feeds into pmek. PIP3 acts on PIP2 and Akt, and there is no direct link between PIP3 and praf.

I went with the correlation check and my recollection of the published network. I did not fit a causal-discovery model.

ANSWER: C
